slides.headline: 1) TYPE PLAIN ENGLISH AND CLAUDE BUILDS THE APP
slides.body: Hiring a developer to build a working app costs $8,000 at the low end. Type this tonight: "Build me a landing page that collects email signups and saves them to a spreadsheet"

slides.headline: 2) CLAUDE COWORK HANDLES YOUR ENTIRE KNOWLEDGE WORKDAY
slides.body: A full-time assistant costs $35,000 a year. Give it: "Read these emails, flag anything urgent, and draft a reply for each one"

slides.headline: 3) CLAUDE IN CHROME BROWSES ANY PAGE FOR YOU
slides.body: A research assistant charges $25 an hour to find and compile information. Try: "Go to this product page and summarize every review that mentions battery life"

slides.headline: 4) CLAUDE IN EXCEL BUILDS THE WHOLE SPREADSHEET
slides.body: Spreadsheet consultants charge $150 an hour to build formulas and dashboards. Type: "Column A is monthly revenue, column B is costs. Build a profit margin chart and flag any month below 20 percent"

slides.headline: 5) CLAUDE IN POWERPOINT WRITES AND DESIGNS YOUR SLIDES
slides.body: A professional presentation designer charges $500 to $2,000 per deck. Tell it: "I am pitching a marketing agency to restaurant owners. Build a 10-slide deck with a problem, solution, case study, and pricing page"

slides.headline: 6) CLAUDE DESIGN MAKES ANYTHING YOU DESCRIBE
slides.body: Freelance designers charge $75 an hour. Type: "Make me a logo for a coffee shop called Slow Pour. Modern, minimal, dark green and cream" and it iterates until you say stop

slides.headline: 7) TAG @CLAUDE IN SLACK AND IT DOES THE TASK
slides.body: Claude Tag turns your team's existing Slack into an AI workspace. Tag it: "@Claude here is this week's sales data. Write a 3-sentence summary for our Friday standup"

slides.headline: SAVE THIS BEFORE YOU NEED IT

caption:
Swipe through all 7 before closing this. Anthropic's leaked system prompt just exposed Claude products most users have never opened. 🔍

Most Claude users open the chat window, type a question, and close the tab.
